name: biocartoon
description: Search open-licensed scientific illustrations, compose whole figures with labels and arrows that open in the BioCartoon editor, download PNG/SVG files with credit lines, and contribute new artwork to BioCartoon.

interface.longDescription: Search the BioCartoon library, compare illustrations in an interactive gallery, download PNG/SVG files with their credit lines, and create and contribute artwork.
defaultPrompt: Find an illustration of a pyramidal neuron for my figure.
Draw a BioCartoon-style icon of a ribosome and submit it.
Which CC0 icons of mitochondria are there?
